records.context: A cycle starts at a cytokinesis (birth) and ends at the next cytokinesis of the same cell (division). On the ``mother`` branch the cell is a mother and the cycle runs between two consecutive buds of hers; on the ``daughter`` branch the cell is a former bud, born at its own separation, and the cycle ends at the cytokinesis of its first bud. Birth size is the cell's size at the birth frame; division size is the cell's plus its bud's size at the division frame; added size is their difference. A cycle whose cytokinesis on either end was not fitted (:func:`budding_cytokinesis`), or whose next bud emerged before the previous one separated, is left out. ``volume`` is the sphere of the same projected area, summed over cell and bud.

records.translation: Un ciclo comienza en una citocinesis (nacimiento) y termina en la siguiente citocinesis de la misma célula (división). En la rama ``mother`` la célula es una madre y el ciclo transcurre entre dos yemas consecutivas suyas; en la rama ``daughter`` la célula es una antigua yema, nacida en su propia separación, y el ciclo termina en la citocinesis de su primera yema. El tamaño al nacer es el tamaño de la célula en el fotograma de nacimiento; el tamaño en la división es el tamaño de la célula más el de su yema en el fotograma de división; el tamaño añadido es su diferencia. Se omite un ciclo cuya citocinesis en cualquiera de sus extremos no se ajustó (:func:`budding_cytokinesis`), o cuya siguiente yema surgió antes de que la anterior se separara. ``volume`` es la esfera con la misma área proyectada, sumada sobre la célula y la yema.

records.translation: Fotograma de citocinesis de cada yema, y cómo se encontró.

records.context: The model this reads (stated, not tested by it): a budding cycle runs from bud emergence, the first frame the bud's track is seen, to cytokinesis. With ``contacts`` (:func:`bud_contacts`), cytokinesis is the last frame the bud touches its mother before they are seen apart on ``min_separated`` consecutive frames on which both are labelled (``method='contact'``). When the masks never show that, the bud's area curve is read instead: the growth rate over ``growth_frames`` frames peaks while the bud grows on its mother, and cytokinesis is the first later frame at which it has fallen to ``plateau_fraction`` of that peak (``method='growth_plateau'``); only frames before the bud's own first bud are read, since a cell cannot bud before it has separated. This assumes the bud's growth slows when it separates, which is a weaker reading than contact: a daughter that keeps growing as fast after separation is not fitted. A bud with neither is not fitted and its ``status`` says why; no cytokinesis time is invented.
records.label: spacr.division_analysis.budding_cytokinesis#1
records.source: The model this reads (stated, not tested by it): a budding cycle runs from bud emergence, the first frame the bud's track is seen, to cytokinesis. With ``contacts`` (:func:`bud_contacts`), cytokinesis is the last frame the bud touches its mother before they are seen apart on ``min_separated`` consecutive frames on which both are labelled (``method='contact'``). When the masks never show that, the bud's area curve is read instead: the growth rate over ``growth_frames`` frames peaks while the bud grows on its mother, and cytokinesis is the first later frame at which it has fallen to ``plateau_fraction`` of that peak (``method='growth_plateau'``); only frames before the bud's own first bud are read, since a cell cannot bud before it has separated. This assumes the bud's growth slows when it separates, which is a weaker reading than contact: a daughter that keeps growing as fast after separation is not fitted. A bud with neither is not fitted and its ``status`` says why; no cytokinesis time is invented.
records.translation: El modelo que se aplica (enunciado, no comprobado por esta función): un ciclo de gemación va desde la aparición de la yema, el primer fotograma en que se ve la trayectoria de la yema, hasta la citocinesis. Con ``contacts`` (:func:`bud_contacts`), la citocinesis es el último fotograma en que la yema toca a su madre antes de que se vean separadas en ``min_separated`` fotogramas consecutivos en los que ambas están etiquetadas (``method='contact'``). Cuando las máscaras nunca lo muestran, se lee en su lugar la curva de área de la yema: la tasa de crecimiento sobre ``growth_frames`` fotogramas alcanza su máximo mientras la yema crece sobre su madre, y la citocinesis es el primer fotograma posterior en el que ha caído a ``plateau_fraction`` de ese máximo (``method='growth_plateau'``); solo se leen los fotogramas anteriores a la primera yema propia de la yema, ya que una célula no puede gemar antes de haberse separado. Esto supone que el crecimiento de la yema se ralentiza cuando se separa, lo que es una lectura más débil que el contacto: una hija que sigue creciendo igual de rápido tras la separación no se ajusta. Una yema sin ninguna de las dos no se ajusta y su ``status`` indica el motivo; no se inventa ningún momento de citocinesis.

Frames whose future the movie does not show are left out rather than called negative. 2. :func:`predict_divisions` -- cross-validation grouped by movie (a fold's test movies are never in its training set) with three controls beside the model: the same learner on age alone, the same learner trained on labels shuffled within each movie, and the majority class. records.translation: 1. :func:`division_prediction_features` -- una fila por célula y fotograma con las mediciones de forma, intensidad y movimiento de :func:`spacr.division_analysis.measure_label_stack` y :func:`~spacr.division_analysis.add_motion_features`, su cambio en los últimos ``history`` fotogramas, la edad de la célula y la etiqueta «se divide en ``frames`` fotogramas». records.context: A cell divides at the alignment frame of :func:`spacr.division_analysis.division_events` (the last frame before a daughter is seen), so the label of frame ``t`` is 1 when that frame lies in ``t .. t + frames - 1``. A frame is labelled 0 only when the cell is seen past ``t + frames`` without dividing or its next division comes later; a frame whose horizon runs past the end of its track without a division is left out, because a lost or departing cell may divide unseen. For budding the mother's divisions are her buds, and her age restarts at each bud emergence; for fission age counts from the track's first frame. Features use the current and earlier frames only.

records.context: Frames of one track are near copies of each other, so by default one labelled frame is drawn per track (per ``movie`` and ``track_id``) with the fixed ``sample_seed``, and every track counts once in training and evaluation. Folds are grouped by movie (scikit-learn ``GroupKFold`` with ``min(folds, number of movies)`` folds), so every prediction is made by a model that never saw that movie. Beside the model, three controls are scored on the same held-out rows: ``age_only`` (the same learner on the cell's age alone), ``shuffled`` (the same learner trained on labels permuted within each training movie, which should score near AUROC 0.5) and ``majority`` (one constant score: AUROC 0.5 and AUPRC equal to the share of positives). AUROC and AUPRC are computed on all held-out predictions together. Their 95% intervals resample movies with replacement from ``min_movies`` movies on; with fewer they resample rows, which treats frames of one cell as independent and is too narrow, and ``ci_note`` says so. The model's margin over each control is resampled in the same draws (paired). Permutation importances (drop in held-out AUROC when one feature is shuffled) are averaged over the folds.
records.label: spacr.division_prediction.predict_divisions#1
records.source: Frames of one track are near copies of each other, so by default one labelled frame is drawn per track (per ``movie`` and ``track_id``) with the fixed ``sample_seed``, and every track counts once in training and evaluation. Folds are grouped by movie (scikit-learn ``GroupKFold`` with ``min(folds, number of movies)`` folds), so every prediction is made by a model that never saw that movie. Beside the model, three controls are scored on the same held-out rows: ``age_only`` (the same learner on the cell's age alone), ``shuffled`` (the same learner trained on labels permuted within each training movie, which should score near AUROC 0.5) and ``majority`` (one constant score: AUROC 0.5 and AUPRC equal to the share of positives). AUROC and AUPRC are computed on all held-out predictions together. Their 95% intervals resample movies with replacement from ``min_movies`` movies on; with fewer they resample rows, which treats frames of one cell as independent and is too narrow, and ``ci_note`` says so. The model's margin over each control is resampled in the same draws (paired). Permutation importances (drop in held-out AUROC when one feature is shuffled) are averaged over the folds.
records.translation: Los fotogramas de una trayectoria son casi copias unos de otros, por lo que de forma predeterminada se extrae un fotograma etiquetado por trayectoria (por ``movie`` y ``track_id``) con el ``sample_seed`` fijo, y cada trayectoria cuenta una vez en el entrenamiento y en la evaluación. Las particiones se agrupan por película (``GroupKFold`` de scikit-learn con ``min(folds, number of movies)`` particiones), de modo que cada predicción la hace un modelo que nunca vio esa película. Junto al modelo, se puntúan tres controles en las mismas filas reservadas: ``age_only`` (el mismo algoritmo solo con la edad de la célula), ``shuffled`` (el mismo algoritmo entrenado con etiquetas permutadas dentro de cada película de entrenamiento, que debería puntuar cerca de AUROC 0.5) y ``majority`` (una puntuación constante: AUROC 0.5 y AUPRC igual a la proporción de positivos). AUROC y AUPRC se calculan sobre todas las predicciones reservadas juntas. Sus intervalos del 95% remuestrean películas con reemplazo a partir de ``min_movies`` películas; con menos, remuestrean filas, lo que trata los fotogramas de una célula como independientes y resulta demasiado estrecho, y ``ci_note`` lo indica. El margen del modelo sobre cada control se remuestrea en las mismas extracciones (emparejado). Las importancias por permutación (caída de la AUROC reservada cuando se baraja una variable) se promedian sobre las particiones.

records.context: A path is read with :func:`spacr.tabular.read_table`, its column names as written; a frame is copied. A per-gene table with two or more ``sgRNA_<k>`` (or ``guide_<k>``) columns becomes one row per guide: ``sgRNA``, ``guide_number``, the guide's own ``sgRNA_<k>_<name>`` values as ``<name>``, every per-gene column, and ``cells``, the sum of the guide's ``*_cells`` columns (interphase and mitotic cells in Funk et al. 2022).
records.label: spacr.published_reference.read_reference#1
records.source: A path is read with :func:`spacr.tabular.read_table`, its column names as written; a frame is copied. A per-gene table with two or more ``sgRNA_<k>`` (or ``guide_<k>``) columns becomes one row per guide: ``sgRNA``, ``guide_number``, the guide's own ``sgRNA_<k>_<name>`` values as ``<name>``, every per-gene column, and ``cells``, the sum of the guide's ``*_cells`` columns (interphase and mitotic cells in Funk et al. 2022).
records.translation: Una ruta se lee con :func:`spacr.tabular.read_table`, con los nombres de columna tal como están escritos; una tabla se copia. Una tabla por gen con dos o más columnas ``sgRNA_<k>`` (o ``guide_<k>``) se convierte en una fila por guía: ``sgRNA``, ``guide_number``, los valores propios ``sgRNA_<k>_<name>`` de la guía como ``<name>``, cada columna por gen, y ``cells``, la suma de las columnas ``*_cells`` de la guía (células en interfase y en mitosis en Funk et al. 2022).

records.source: The interval is the 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of the correlation over resamples of the matched guides or genes, drawn with replacement. The control shuffles the screen values across the matched rows, which breaks the gene labels and keeps both distributions: a reanalysis that agrees only as well as its shuffled control does not reproduce the published screen.
records.translation: El intervalo va del percentil 2.5 al 97.5 de la correlación sobre remuestreos de las guías o genes emparejados, extraídos con reemplazo. El control baraja los valores del cribado entre las filas emparejadas, lo que rompe las etiquetas de los genes y conserva ambas distribuciones: un reanálisis que concuerda solo tan bien como su control barajado no reproduce el cribado publicado.
